summary: Verified Settings page cache invalidation fix (api.js updateOperationalSettings now invalidates getOperationalSettings cache). Logged in as manager@germanfluid.com, navigated to /settings and confirmed that toggling boolean settings, reverting them, and editing number inputs all reflect the new value in UI immediately after save (no page reload). Badge transitions from 'Inherited' to 'Set here' also update in place.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in api.js line 749-754 is correct: _invalidateCache(['getOperationalSettings:']) is chained on the update .then(). Prefix matches cache key format from _cacheKey('getOperationalSettings', args).

Note: 'High impact' toggles (e.g. Allow Direct Vendor Purchase) open a confirmation modal — this is expected behavior, not a bug. Confirming via Enable/Disable button in the dialog completes the update and UI updates without reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested with testid selectors: toggle-allow_over_receive (bool without confirm modal), toggle-reserve_on_approve (bool), input-near_expiry_alert_days (number). Full list of toggle-* and input-* testids available in Settings/OperationalSettings.jsx. Confirmation modal has role=dialog with Enable/Disable/Confirm buttons for high-impact settings.
verified_scenarios: Boolean toggle ON -> UI reflects checked state immediately after save (no reload)
Boolean toggle back OFF -> UI reflects unchecked state immediately after save
Badge 'Inherited' -> 'Set here' updates immediately after first-time save on inherited setting
Number input (near_expiry_alert_days) 3 -> 7 persists after blur without reload; revert to 3 also works
